set.body:
Bounded protocol slice before optimization. Specify exact comparator/source/runtime pins, machine/toolchain, dataset identities, scale levels, output equivalence, I-DT/boundary convention treatment, thread/cache policies, warm-up/repetitions and uncertainty method. Separate cold startup, warm computation, end-to-end materialization and UI latency.

Enumerate every PM3 mandatory workload and define numeric per-workload regression budgets, aggregate speed and large-workload memory improvement thresholds, absolute budgets for eyes4s-only operations, aggregation weights and noise handling. Thresholds must represent a meaningful research benefit, be set before optimization/final evaluation, and may not be weakened after observing results without an explicit owner decision. Include peak RSS and allocation/GC as distinct measures.

Acceptance: reviewable versioned protocol, machine-readable configuration and receipt schema, with checks for omitted workloads, mismatched units/outputs and missing environment/version fields. Existing scientific differences are explicit; not all detectors with the same name are interchangeable. Identify the first runnable paired baseline and queue bounded slices for every remaining workload. No performance-superiority claim at this stage.
set.title: PM3.1 Freeze fair paired workloads and numeric performance budgets
